name: Kex Template (Markdown)
_comment: The Markdown host of a .ket template (kexhq/kex#314) — see ket-html.tmLanguage.json for why the host needs its own grammar, and why the tags are an L-injection. Markdown makes that especially plain: a heading rule owns the whole line from its `#`, so `# <%= name %>` keeps its tag only because the injection outranks it.
